title: Coral and the Drop
author: Odile Lockridge
blurb: Hazel Montrose, a whistle-blower living under four names, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. But when every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must burn the network that did the training, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
